# Get-ZbxActiveProxyStatus

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the running active proxy sessions.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxActiveProxyStatus [[-Name] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxActiveProxyStatus cmdlet writes the active proxy sessions running in this runspace, or the one named in -Name: each with its name, the proxy it acts as, when it started, when it last pulled the configuration, and the configuration it holds. It reads only the runspace's own sessions and sends nothing. Start-ZbxActiveProxy starts a session and Stop-ZbxActiveProxy ends it.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: List the running active proxy sessions

```powershell
Get-ZbxActiveProxyStatus | Select-Object Name, Started, LastPulledAt
```

Every active proxy session of this runspace.

### Example 2: Check when a session last pulled its configuration

```powershell
(Get-ZbxActiveProxyStatus -Name 'uplink').LastPulledAt
```

LastPulledAt is empty until the server has answered a pull.

## PARAMETERS

### -Name

The session's name; every running active-proxy session when omitted.

## INPUTS

None.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixActiveProxySession`: Represents an active proxy's uplink kept running as a session: it re-pulls the configuration on -RefreshInterval, over a ZabbixProxyUplink built with no DI container — the SDK type composes over a plain .
